note: Per-slide narration for the self-paced and SCORM editions. Edit the text, push to main, and the generate-narration workflow re-creates assets/audio/narr-<id>.mp3 for each section and rebuilds the SCORM package. voice_id is an ElevenLabs voice; swap it to change the narrator.

sections.s-hero: Welcome to the Talent Marketplace, Vanderbilt's home for your growth and development. In the next fifteen minutes you will learn what the marketplace is, find your own way in, walk the path from everyday growth to a landed move, and see the promises that make it safe. Stay at Vanderbilt. Go somewhere new.
sections.s-charge: First, the why. Vanderbilt's charge is bold: define the great university of the twenty-first century, and be it. That takes exceptional core operations, bold strategic initiatives, and values leadership. Every one of them runs on talent, and growing our own people is how we get there. Dare to grow.
sections.s-what: So what is it? Two things, one marketplace. Path one: careers of interest. Name where you want to grow, build toward it, and see openings before the public does. Path two: short projects in other units that build your skills while your home job stays yours. Both live in Oracle, both stay private until you act, and leaders only ever see group totals. When you are ready, play the fact or fiction game to test yourself.
sections.s-entrances: There are six doors into the marketplace, and they group into three kinds of talent. Looking to grow: the curious, the plateaued, and the ready. Hidden talent: great in the role, with skills the role never asks for. And not a fit but right mission: after a reorg, or when a role is at risk. Yours might be a mix. Every door opens best the same way: a growth conversation with your manager. Open each door to see the path.
sections.s-process: The process is simple. Every day, you build: keep your skills honest and current, flag your careers of interest, and take learning tied to your goals. Then, when opportunity arises, you pursue it: staff see eligible openings first, the interviews are fair, and a chosen move ends with a planned handoff. Grow every day, and be ready when opportunity arises.
sections.s-culture: Now the culture work. Research found that about three out of four managers admit to holding on to strong team members, and that pressure stops people from moving inside. So the promises are plain. No retaliation. No watching. And managers coach: thank you for telling me, what drew you to it, and how can I help you prepare well? Releasing talent is a leadership win. The university keeps the skills, and your record shows the development.
sections.s-plan: Time to make it yours. Take the recap quiz, then work the five moves in the job aid. Have a growth conversation with your manager. Build a plan with the Talent Marketplace tool. Update your career preferences in Oracle. Keep your skills current and honestly leveled. And flag your careers of interest in the Grow area. Each move is small. Print the job aid and start today.
sections.s-close: One last breath. The Talent Marketplace is Vanderbilt's home for your growth and development: identify where you want to grow, build the skills with your manager's support, and pursue opportunities inside the university when they arise. Your one next step is a conversation with your manager about your growth and development. Thank you for spending fifteen minutes here. Now go grow.
